card.description: A towering 12‑meter obelisk forged from layered obsidian plates fused with bronze filigree, its apex crowned by a translucent crystal housing a bioluminescent core. Intricate Ethiopian hieroglyphs glow faintly along the shaft, while copper conduits radiate a subtle amber light, making the structure a living nexus of ancient mysticism and incomprehensible technology.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** 12‑meter tall, tapering obelisk composed of obsidian plates bonded with bronze filigree, base carved with runic engravings.
**Face/Sensors:** Apex contains a translucent crystal core that pulses with bioluminescent light; surrounding copper conduits glow faintly, acting as energy conduits.
**Key Features:** Ethiopian hieroglyphic panels etched in luminous pigment, copper conduit lattice, central crystalline core, bio‑luminescent veins, bronze filigree detailing.
evolution: Phase 1 (Initial Activation): The core emits a low‑frequency hum, glyphs glow faintly, copper conduits emit a soft amber glow.
Phase 2 (Full Power): The core pulses brighter, glyphs flare, copper conduits glow intensely, the obelisk emits a halo of bioluminescent light.
props: Item: Obsidian Core – a polished crystal core that pulses with bioluminescent light.
Item: Copper Conduit Array – a lattice of copper channels etched with runes.
